column3: The Hebrew calls the LORD’s word “refined”; BSB uses “flawless.”
The Hebrew says “my heights”; BSB says “the heights.”
The Hebrew says “my step”; BSB says “the path.”
The Hebrew says “girded me” with strength; BSB uses “armed me.”
The Hebrew says that He gave the enemies’ neck to David; BSB renders this image as making them retreat.
The Hebrew uses the image “sons of the foreigner” and “at the hearing of the ear”; BSB uses “foreigners” and “when they hear me.”
The Hebrew says “a man of violence” in the singular; BSB uses plural “violent men.”
The Hebrew uses “tower of salvations” and singular “seed”; BSB says “Great salvation He brings” and “descendants.”
